why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Colt Keith is slot #6 (4.465 expected team runs/game).
Slots #6, #7, #8, #5, #9, #4, #1, #3, #2 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #3 ranks 8 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.004 R/G.
Slot #6 yields 4.12 expected PA/game vs 4.44 at primary slot #3. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Power (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
Cleanup (#4) models -0.001 R/G vs his average placement — typically less value than mid/lower-order spots when power/run-production profiles are modest relative to the nine.
